Follow-on assurance slice opened: [MATERIAL-ACCOUNTED-EVIDENCE-INDEPENDENCE-001 #5949](https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/symtropy/issues/5949).

It composes the Stage 0 receipt contract in [#5879 / PR #5912](https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/symtropy/pull/5912) with Mycelix's existing [LEX-NET-030 #1243](https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/mycelix/issues/1243) source-dependency model and [ASSURE-PORTFOLIO-CUT-002 #5762](https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/mycelix/issues/5762) multi-valued/transitive dependency projection. The test target is to expose shared sources, instruments, calibration chains and transitive common causes across distinct gate receipts, while keeping incomplete lineage indeterminate. This does not add another generic graph, cut-set engine or trust model.

## New economics and source-lineage tranches — 18 November 2026

Two focused child tracks now complement the eight-gate receipt composition work:

1. [MATERIAL-ACCOUNTED-EVIDENCE-INDEPENDENCE-001 #5949](https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/symtropy/issues/5949): manufacturing consumer adapter for Mycelix #1243/#6124 and #5762/#6121. It preserves claim-specific common-source dependencies and transitive witnesses; it does not create another dependency graph.
2. [FACTORY-ACCEPTED-OUTPUT-ECONOMICS-001 #5966](https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/symtropy/issues/5966), implementation [draft PR #5970](https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/symtropy/pull/5970): pump/valve-specific cost accounting per unique released output. It consumes route eligibility and accepted disposition, does not reuse #5434's dimensionless relative cost units as money, and is aligned as a domain adapter to Symthaea MFG-VALUE-001 #7608.

PR #5970 currently carries 20 synthetic cases, 50 cost-item rows, 46 final output disposition rows and 26 authored Rust tests. An independent JavaScript fixture replay matched the 20 hand-calculated expected rows. Hosted exact-head Rust CI is queued; no compile/test pass is claimed.

## Product-specific acceptance mapping added — 18 November 2026

New child [PUMP-VALVE-ACCEPTANCE-MAPPING-001 #5987](https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/symtropy/issues/5987) captures the current pump and metallic-valve test-standard applicability boundary.

Verified sources show:
- ISO 9906:2012 remains the published rotodynamic pump hydraulic acceptance-test edition, now shown under periodic review; scope is centrifugal/mixed/axial flow, clear/cold-water behavior, acceptance testing at test facilities.
- ANSI/HI 14.6-2022 is the most-recent HI rotodynamic pump acceptance-test edition; it covers performance, NPSH and hydrostatic testing, grades and recording/reporting, with exact pump type/test boundary to be declared.
- ISO 5208:2015 was confirmed in 2025 and remains current for metallic industrial valve pressure-boundary/closure tests; it must be used with the applicable product standard and explicitly excludes pressure-test safety.
- API 598 11th edition (Feb 2023) is listed current for its defined valve types and contract contexts.

South African municipal/tender documents use SANS/ISO 9906 references in specific procurement specifications. Those are not enough to claim national SABS adoption or a universal grade. The new work records that uncertainty and requires exact contract/authority scope.

This maps acceptance evidence; it does not encode proprietary normative clauses or authorize physical pressure testing.

comments.author: Tristan-Stoltz-ERC
comments.text:
## Pump/valve acceptance compiler increment — 18 November 2026

The standards child [#5987 / draft PR #5994](https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/symtropy/pull/5994) is now an executable, source-bounded applicability classifier with 6 profiles and 35 synthetic scenarios.

It binds each standard profile to a catalogue snapshot date and each scenario to an assessment-as-of date; historical applicability abstains without a matching snapshot. Purchaser agreement, fitting agreement and product-standard declarations require exact reference identifiers. The 25-field output receipt carries the standard source/edition/snapshot, scenario applicability inputs, exact contract references, disposition and reason.

This composes with #4959's physical/system service benchmark and does not declare conformity, certification, SABS adoption, pressure-test safety, or product release. Exact-head Rust CI is queued; 35/35 source/fixture replay is not a Rust test pass.
